content.text:
I submitted index 13 (Sb fraction 0.249) as the best composition. It had the highest EQE of the five I measured, but every value on this Bi–Sb–O line is tiny and the top three differ only slightly.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | 0.080 | 0.00046 |
| 11 | 0.198 | 0.00062 |
| **13** | **0.249** | **0.00065** |
| 15 | 0.303 | 0.00054 |
| 21 | 0.511 | 0.00023 |

- **Where the peak is:** EQE rises up to about Sb 0.2–0.3 and then falls. The Sb 0.5 region, where BiSbO₄ would form, is the weakest.
- **XRD:** I scanned indices 9, 13 and 17 (Sb 0.15, 0.25, 0.38). Each pattern contains the FTO substrate's peaks plus a Bi-rich phase that gets weaker as Sb goes up and is faint by Sb 0.38. I couldn't pin that phase down: the closest matches were Bi₂O₃ (0.69 similarity) and Bi₃SbO₇ (0.63), which is too close to call. Bi₃SbO₇'s Sb fraction of 0.25 does line up with the EQE peak.
- **Limits:** I used all five EQE measurements and three of the five XRD scans. Nothing below Sb 0.08 or between 0.51 and 0.72 was measured, so a better composition on the line can't be ruled out, though the trend makes one unlikely.
